title: Delete Assignment
description: Deletes a reservation assignment. This removes the association between a project, folder, or organization and a reservation. After deletion, jobs from the formerly assigned resource will no longer use the reservation's slots.

objective.narrative: This shows how to delete a reservation assignment. No expansion will happen. For example, if the organization has a reservation assignment and a project under the organization has a reservation assignment, deleting the organization's assignment will not affect the project's assignment.
